name: TNLean.PEPS.piProduct_forms_scalar
statement:
theorem piProduct_forms_scalar (M N : (i : ι) → Matrix (n i) (n i) ℂ)
    (hN : ∀ i, IsUnit (N i)) [hne : ∀ i, Nonempty (n i)]
    (h : ∀ (p q : (i : ι) → n i),
        (∏ i, M i (p i) (q i)) = ∏ i, N i (p i) (q i)) :
    ∃ c : ι → ℂ, (∀ i, M i = c i • N i) ∧ (∏ i, c i) = 1

name: TNLean.PEPS.threeLeg_residual_forms_scalar
statement:
theorem threeLeg_residual_forms_scalar [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] [Nonempty γ]
    (Z : Matrix (β × γ) (β × γ) ℂ)
    (U : Matrix (α × β) (α × β) ℂ)
    (W : Matrix (α × γ) (α × γ) ℂ)
    (hZU : threeLegLeftIdentityForm (α := α) Z = threeLegRightIdentityForm U)
    (hZW : threeLegLeftIdentityForm (α := α) Z = threeLegMiddleIdentityForm W) :
    ∃ lam : ℂ, Z = lam • 1 ∧ U = lam • 1 ∧ W = lam • 1

TNLean.PEPS.linearIndependent_recombine
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_recombine {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {M : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℂ M]
    (f : ι → M) (hf : LinearIndependent ℂ f)

    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i => ∑ j, K i j • f j)

name: TNLean.PEPS.localGauge_exists
statement:
theorem localGauge_exists (A B : Tensor G d)
    (hA : IsVertexInjective A)
    (hDim : A.bondDim = B.bondDim) (v : V)
    (hFactorized : HasFactorizedLocalGauge A B hA hDim v) :
    ∃ (Xv : (e : Edge G) → GL (Fin (A.bondDim e)) ℂ),
      ∀ (η : (ie : IncidentEdge G v) → Fin (A.bondDim ie.1)) (σ : Fin d),
        B.component v (fun ie => Fin.cast (congr_fun hDim ie.1) (η ie)) σ =
          ∑ η' : (ie : IncidentEdge G v) → Fin (A.bondDim ie.1),
            (∏ ie : IncidentEdge G v,
              (↑(Xv ie.1) : Matrix _ _ ℂ) (η ie) (η' ie)) *
              A.component v η' σ

name: TNLean.PEPS.perVertexScalar
statement:
theorem perVertexScalar (A B : Tensor G d)
    (hA : IsVertexInjective A) (hB : IsVertexInjective B)
    (hpos : ∀ e : Edge G, 0 < A.bondDim e)
    (Z : (e : Edge G) → GL (Fin (B.bondDim e)) ℂ)
    (hPA : PostAbsorptionEdgeInsertionEquality A (absorbEdgeGauges B Z))
    (v : V) [Nonempty (IncidentEdge G v)] :
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (η : (ie : IncidentEdge G v) → Fin (A.bondDim ie.1)) (σ : Fin d),
      A.component v η σ =
        c * gaugeVertex B Z v
          (fun ie => Fin.cast (congr_fun hPA.bondDim_eq ie.1) (η ie)) σ

name: TNLean.PEPS.piProductKernel_isUnit

theorem piProductKernel_isUnit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (n i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (n i)]
    (M Minv : (i : ι) → Matrix (n i) (n i) ℂ)
    (hMl : ∀ i, M i * Minv i = 1) (hMr : ∀ i, Minv i * M i = 1) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.of (fun η η' : (i : ι) → n i => ∏ i, M i (η i) (η' i)))

name: TNLean.PEPS.piProductKernel_mul
statement:
theorem piProductKernel_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (n i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (n i)]
    (M Minv : (i : ι) → Matrix (n i) (n i) ℂ)
    (hMl : ∀ i, M i * Minv i = 1) :
    (Matrix.of (fun η η' : (i : ι) → n i => ∏ i, M i (η i) (η' i))) *
      (Matrix.of (fun η η' : (i : ι) → n i => ∏ i, Minv i (η i) (η' i))) = 1

name: TNLean.PEPS.prod_region_insert_split
statement:
theorem prod_region_insert_split (A : Tensor G d) (R : Finset V) {v : V} (hv : v ∉ R)
    (ζ : VirtualConfig A)
    (σ : RegionPhysicalConfig (V := V) (d := d) (insert v R)) :
    (∏ w : {w : V // w ∈ insert v R}, A.component w.1 (fun ie => ζ ie.1) (σ w)) =
      A.component v (fun ie => ζ ie.1) (σ ⟨v, Finset.mem_insert_self v R⟩) *
        ∏ w : {w : V // w ∈ R}, A.component w.1 (fun ie => ζ ie.1)
          (restrictInsertPhysical (V := V) (d := d) R σ w)

name: TNLean.PEPS.regionBlockedWeight_insert_eq_sum_split
statement:
theorem regionBlockedWeight_insert_eq_sum_split (A : Tensor G d) (R : Finset V)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∉ R)
    (μ : RegionBoundaryConfig (G := G) A (insert v R))
    (σ : RegionPhysicalConfig (V := V) (d := d) (insert v R)) :
    regionBlockedWeight (G := G) A (insert v R) μ σ =
      ∑ ζ ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun ζ : VirtualConfig A =>
            regionBoundaryLabel (G := G) A (insert v R) ζ = μ),
        A.component v (fun ie => ζ ie.1) (σ ⟨v, Finset.mem_insert_self v R⟩) *
          ∏ w : {w : V // w ∈ R}, A.component w.1 (fun ie => ζ ie.1)
            (restrictInsertPhysical (V := V) (d := d) R σ w)

name: TNLean.PEPS.regionBoundaryLabel_eq_boundaryLabelOfInsert

theorem regionBoundaryLabel_eq_boundaryLabelOfInsert (A : Tensor G d) (R : Finset V)

    (η : LocalVirtualConfig A v)
    (hμ : regionBoundaryLabel (G := G) A (insert v R) ζ = μ)
    (hη : (fun ie : IncidentEdge G v => ζ ie.1) = η) :
    regionBoundaryLabel (G := G) A R ζ =
      boundaryLabelOfInsert (G := G) A R hv μ η

name: TNLean.PEPS.isRegionBoundaryEdge_cornerRegion

    IsRegionBoundaryEdge (G := torusGraph width height) cornerRegion

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_cornerRegion
statement:
theorem mem_cornerRegion (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ cornerRegion ↔
      (3 ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < 5 ∧ 2 ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < 5) ∨
        (2 ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < 5 ∧ 3 ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < 5)

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusHorizontalEdgeBlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusHorizontalEdgeBlue (xStart yStart : ℕ) (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusHorizontalEdgeBlue xStart yStart ↔
      xStart + 2 ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < xStart + 5 ∧
        yStart + 1 ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < yStart + 3

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusHorizontalEdgeComplement
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusHorizontalEdgeComplement (xStart yStart : ℕ)
    (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusHorizontalEdgeComplement xStart yStart ↔
      v ∉ torusHorizontalEdgeRed xStart yStart ∧ v ∉ torusHorizontalEdgeBlue xStart yStart

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusHorizontalEdgeRed
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusHorizontalEdgeRed (xStart yStart : ℕ) (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusHorizontalEdgeRed xStart yStart ↔
      xStart ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < xStart + 2 ∧
        yStart + 2 ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < yStart + 5

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusVerticalEdgeBlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusVerticalEdgeBlue (xStart yStart : ℕ) (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusVerticalEdgeBlue xStart yStart ↔
      xStart + 1 ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < xStart + 3 ∧
        yStart + 2 ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < yStart + 5

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusVerticalEdgeComplement
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusVerticalEdgeComplement (xStart yStart : ℕ)
    (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusVerticalEdgeComplement xStart yStart ↔
      v ∉ torusVerticalEdgeRed xStart yStart ∧ v ∉ torusVerticalEdgeBlue xStart yStart

name: TNLean.PEPS.mem_torusVerticalEdgeRed
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_torusVerticalEdgeRed (xStart yStart : ℕ) (v : TorusVertex width height) :
    v ∈ torusVerticalEdgeRed xStart yStart ↔
      xStart + 2 ≤ v.1.val ∧ v.1.val < xStart + 5 ∧
        yStart ≤ v.2.val ∧ v.2.val < yStart + 2

name: TNLean.PEPS.torusHorizontalEdgeBlue_disjoint_complement

theorem torusHorizontalEdgeRed_disjoint_complement (xStart yStart : ℕ) :

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_refl {d : ℕ} {Λ : Finset ℤ} (x : Config d Λ) : restrict (by rfl) x = x

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_sdiff_splitEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_sdiff_splitEquiv_symm {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (h : Λ ⊆ Γ)
    (p : Config d Λ × Config d (Γ \ Λ)) :
    restrict (Finset.sdiff_subset : Γ \ Λ ⊆ Γ) ((splitEquiv h).symm p) = p.2

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_splitEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_splitEquiv_symm {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (h : Λ ⊆ Γ)
    (p : Config d Λ × Config d (Γ \ Λ)) :
    restrict h ((splitEquiv h).symm p) = p.1

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_trans
statement:
lemma restrict_trans {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ Δ : Finset ℤ} (hΛΓ : Λ ⊆ Γ) (hΓΔ : Γ ⊆ Δ)
    (x : Config d Δ) : restrict hΛΓ (restrict hΓΔ x) = restrict (hΛΓ.trans hΓΔ) x

name: SpinChain.Config.splitEquiv_sdiff_snd_eq_iff_restrict
statement:
lemma splitEquiv_sdiff_snd_eq_iff_restrict {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (h : Λ ⊆ Γ)
    (x y : Config d Γ) :
    (splitEquiv (Finset.sdiff_subset : Γ \ Λ ⊆ Γ) x).2 =
        (splitEquiv (Finset.sdiff_subset : Γ \ Λ ⊆ Γ) y).2 ↔
      restrict h x = restrict h y

name: SpinChain.Config.splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_sdiff
statement:
lemma splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_sdiff {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (h : Λ ⊆ Γ)
    (x y : Config d Γ) :
    (splitEquiv h x).2 = (splitEquiv h y).2 ↔
      restrict (Finset.sdiff_subset : Γ \ Λ ⊆ Γ) x =
        restrict (Finset.sdiff_subset : Γ \ Λ ⊆ Γ) y

name: SpinChain.Config.disjointUnionEquiv_apply_fst
statement:
@[simp]
lemma disjointUnionEquiv_apply_fst {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ)
    (x : Config d (Λ ∪ Γ)) :
    (disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ x).1 = restrict Finset.subset_union_left x

name: SpinChain.Config.disjointUnionEquiv_apply_snd
statement:
@[simp]
lemma disjointUnionEquiv_apply_snd {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ)
    (x : Config d (Λ ∪ Γ)) :
    (disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ x).2 = restrict Finset.subset_union_right x

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_disjointUnionEquiv_symm_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_disjointUnionEquiv_symm_left {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ}
    (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ) (x : Config d Λ × Config d Γ) :
    restrict Finset.subset_union_left ((disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ).symm x) = x.1

name: SpinChain.Config.restrict_disjointUnionEquiv_symm_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_disjointUnionEquiv_symm_right {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ}
    (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ) (x : Config d Λ × Config d Γ) :
    restrict Finset.subset_union_right ((disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ).symm x) = x.2

name: SpinChain.Config.splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_left
statement:
lemma splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_left {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ}
    (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ) (x y : Config d (Λ ∪ Γ)) :
    (splitEquiv Finset.subset_union_right x).2 =
        (splitEquiv Finset.subset_union_right y).2 ↔
      restrict Finset.subset_union_left x = restrict Finset.subset_union_left y

name: SpinChain.Config.splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_right
statement:
lemma splitEquiv_snd_eq_iff_restrict_right {d : ℕ} {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ}
    (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ) (x y : Config d (Λ ∪ Γ)) :
    (splitEquiv Finset.subset_union_left x).2 =
        (splitEquiv Finset.subset_union_left y).2 ↔
      restrict Finset.subset_union_right x = restrict Finset.subset_union_right y

name: SpinChain.bipartiteLocalAlgebraEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bipartiteLocalAlgebraEquiv_apply (hΛΓ : Disjoint Λ Γ)
    (A : LocalAlgebra d (Λ ∪ Γ)) (x y : Config d Λ × Config d Γ) :
    bipartiteLocalAlgebraEquiv hΛΓ A x y =
      A ((Config.disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ).symm x)
        ((Config.disjointUnionEquiv hΛΓ).symm y)

name: SpinChain.Config.translation_add
statement:
lemma translation_add (d : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (x : Config d Λ) (i : Λ) :
    translation d b (translateRegion a Λ) (translation d a Λ x)
        (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight b).toEmbedding (translateRegion a Λ)
          (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ i)) =
      translation d (a + b) Λ x
        (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight (a + b)).toEmbedding Λ i)

name: SpinChain.Config.translation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma translation_apply (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (x : Config d Λ) (i : translateRegion a Λ) :
    translation d a Λ x i =
      x ((Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ).symm i)

name: SpinChain.Config.translation_apply_siteTranslation
statement:
@[simp]
lemma translation_apply_siteTranslation (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (x : Config d Λ) (i : Λ) :
    translation d a Λ x (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ i) = x i

name: SpinChain.Config.translation_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma translation_symm_apply (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (x : Config d (translateRegion a Λ)) (i : Λ) :
    (translation d a Λ).symm x i =
      x (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ i)

name: SpinChain.Config.translation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma translation_zero (d : ℕ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (x : Config d Λ) (i : Λ) :
    translation d 0 Λ x (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight 0).toEmbedding Λ i) = x i

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_add
statement:
lemma localTranslation_add (d : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (A : LocalAlgebra d Λ) (x y : Config d Λ) :
    localTranslation d b (translateRegion a Λ) (localTranslation d a Λ A)
        (Config.translation d b (translateRegion a Λ) (Config.translation d a Λ x))
        (Config.translation d b (translateRegion a Λ) (Config.translation d a Λ y)) =
      localTranslation d (a + b) Λ A
        (Config.translation d (a + b) Λ x) (Config.translation d (a + b) Λ y)

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma localTranslation_apply (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (A : LocalAlgebra d Λ) (x y : Config d (translateRegion a Λ)) :
    localTranslation d a Λ A x y =
      A ((Config.translation d a Λ).symm x) ((Config.translation d a Λ).symm y)

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_apply_translation
statement:
@[simp]
lemma localTranslation_apply_translation (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (A : LocalAlgebra d Λ) (x y : Config d Λ) :
    localTranslation d a Λ A (Config.translation d a Λ x) (Config.translation d a Λ y) =
      A x y

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_isometry
statement:
lemma localTranslation_isometry (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) :
    Isometry (localTranslation d a Λ)

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_norm
statement:
lemma localTranslation_norm (d : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (A : LocalAlgebra d Λ) :
    ‖localTranslation d a Λ A‖ = ‖A‖

name: SpinChain.localTranslation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma localTranslation_zero (d : ℕ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (A : LocalAlgebra d Λ) (x y : Config d Λ) :
    localTranslation d 0 Λ A (Config.translation d 0 Λ x) (Config.translation d 0 Λ y) =
      A x y

name: SpinChain.mem_translateRegion
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_translateRegion (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    i ∈ translateRegion a Λ ↔ i - a ∈ Λ

name: SpinChain.mem_translateRegion_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_translateRegion_add (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    i + a ∈ translateRegion a Λ ↔ i ∈ Λ

name: SpinChain.siteTranslation_add
statement:
lemma siteTranslation_add (a b : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (i : Λ) :
    (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight b).toEmbedding (translateRegion a Λ)
        (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ i) : ℤ) =
      (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight (a + b)).toEmbedding Λ i : ℤ)

name: SpinChain.siteTranslation_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma siteTranslation_apply_val (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) (i : Λ) :
    (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ i : ℤ) = i + a

name: SpinChain.siteTranslation_symm_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma siteTranslation_symm_apply_val (a : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ)
    (i : translateRegion a Λ) :
    ((Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight a).toEmbedding Λ).symm i : ℤ) = i - a

name: SpinChain.siteTranslation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma siteTranslation_zero (Λ : Finset ℤ) (i : Λ) :
    (Finset.equivMap (Equiv.addRight 0).toEmbedding Λ i : ℤ) = i

name: SpinChain.translateRegion_add
statement:
lemma translateRegion_add (a b : ℤ) (Λ : Finset ℤ) :
    translateRegion b (translateRegion a Λ) = translateRegion (a + b) Λ

name: SpinChain.translateRegion_mono
statement:
lemma translateRegion_mono (a : ℤ) {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (h : Λ ⊆ Γ) :
    translateRegion a Λ ⊆ translateRegion a Γ

name: SpinChain.translateRegion_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma translateRegion_zero (Λ : Finset ℤ) : translateRegion 0 Λ = Λ

name: SpinChain.disjoint_regionSumset_neg_iff
statement:
lemma disjoint_regionSumset_neg_iff {Γ Λ 𝓝 : Finset ℤ} :
    Disjoint Γ (regionSumset Λ (-𝓝)) ↔ Disjoint (regionSumset Γ 𝓝) Λ

name: SpinChain.mem_regionSumset
statement:
lemma mem_regionSumset (i : ℤ) (Λ 𝓝 : Finset ℤ) :
    i ∈ regionSumset Λ 𝓝 ↔ ∃ j ∈ Λ, ∃ a ∈ 𝓝, j + a = i

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_assoc
statement:
lemma regionSumset_assoc (Λ 𝓝 𝓜 : Finset ℤ) :
    regionSumset (regionSumset Λ 𝓝) 𝓜 = regionSumset Λ (regionSumset 𝓝 𝓜)

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_mono
statement:
lemma regionSumset_mono {Λ Γ 𝓝 𝓜 : Finset ℤ} (hΛ : Λ ⊆ Γ) (h𝓝 : 𝓝 ⊆ 𝓜) :
    regionSumset Λ 𝓝 ⊆ regionSumset Γ 𝓜

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_mono_left
statement:
lemma regionSumset_mono_left {Λ Γ : Finset ℤ} (𝓝 : Finset ℤ) (h : Λ ⊆ Γ) :
    regionSumset Λ 𝓝 ⊆ regionSumset Γ 𝓝

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_mono_right
statement:
lemma regionSumset_mono_right (Λ : Finset ℤ) {𝓝 𝓜 : Finset ℤ} (h : 𝓝 ⊆ 𝓜) :
    regionSumset Λ 𝓝 ⊆ regionSumset Λ 𝓜

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_singleton_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma regionSumset_singleton_right (Λ : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ) :
    regionSumset Λ {a} = translateRegion a Λ

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma regionSumset_zero_left (𝓝 : Finset ℤ) : regionSumset {0} 𝓝 = 𝓝

name: SpinChain.regionSumset_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma regionSumset_zero_right (Λ : Finset ℤ) : regionSumset Λ {0} = Λ

name: _private.TNLean.Algebra.CommutingProjectionProduct.0.LinearMap.apply_list_prod_one_sub_eq_self
statement:
private theorem apply_list_prod_one_sub_eq_self
    (P : List (E →ₗ[𝕜] E)) (v : E) (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p v = 0) :
    (P.map fun p ↦ (1 : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) - p).prod v = v

name: _private.TNLean.Algebra.CommutingProjectionProduct.0.LinearMap.list_prod_one_sub_isIdempotentElem
statement:
private theorem list_prod_one_sub_isIdempotentElem
    (P : List (E →ₗ[𝕜] E)) (hcomm : P.Pairwise fun p q ↦ Commute p q)
    (hidem : ∀ p ∈ P, IsIdempotentElem p) :
    IsIdempotentElem (P.map fun p ↦ (1 : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) - p).prod

name: _private.TNLean.Algebra.CommutingProjectionProduct.0.LinearMap.mul_list_prod_one_sub_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem mul_list_prod_one_sub_eq_zero
    (P : List (E →ₗ[𝕜] E)) (hcomm : P.Pairwise fun p q ↦ Commute p q)
    (hidem : ∀ p ∈ P, IsIdempotentElem p) {p : E →ₗ[𝕜] E} (hp : p ∈ P) :
    p * (P.map fun q ↦ (1 : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) - q).prod = 0
